items.title: Energy Dome and its carbon dioxide batteries
items.description: There’s a growing need for long-duration storage to meet energy demand and balance out renewables on the grid. Energy Dome uses compressed carbon dioxide gas in its massive grid batteries, which can deliver power for up to 24 hours. As the world races to meet growing electricity demand, solar and onshore wind power have become…
items.title_vi: Energy Dome và pin carbon dioxide của nó
